#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Append a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx."""
import os
import re
import sys
import zipfile

PPTX = "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
MSG = "Thank you for your attention"

if not os.path.exists(PPTX):
    sys.exit(f"error: {PPTX} not found")


def verify_pptx(path):
    """Re-open the saved deck and confirm the last slide carries the message."""
    try:
        from pptx import Presentation

        prs = Presentation(path)
        last = prs.slides[-1]
        texts = []
        for sh in last.shapes:
            if sh.has_text_frame:
                texts.append(sh.text_frame.text)
        ok = any(MSG in t for t in texts)
        print(f"verified: {len(prs.slides)} slides; last-slide texts={texts!r}; found={ok}")
        return ok
    except ImportError:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
            slides = sorted(
                int(m.group(1))
                for n in z.namelist()
                if (m := re.match(r"ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml$", n))
            )
            xml = z.read(f"ppt/slides/slide{slides[-1]}.xml").decode("utf-8")
        ok = MSG in xml and "Thank you for your attention" in xml
        print(f"verified (zip): {len(slides)} slides; last slide contains message: {ok}")
        return ok
    except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover
        print(f"verify failed: {e}")
        return False


def add_with_pptx():
    from pptx import Presentation
    from pptx.enum.text import MSO_ANCHOR, PP_ALIGN
    from pptx.util import Pt

    prs = Presentation(PPTX)
    layouts = prs.slide_layouts
    layout = next((c for c in layouts if c.name and "blank" in c.name.lower()), layouts[-1])
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(layout)
    sw, sh = prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(int(sw * 0.08), int(sh * 0.38), int(sw * 0.84), int(sh * 0.24))
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    r = p.add_run()
    r.text = MSG
    r.font.size = Pt(40)
    r.font.bold = True
    tmp = PPTX + ".tmp"
    prs.save(tmp)
    os.replace(tmp, PPTX)


def add_with_zip():
    """Raw OOXML fallback (per skill ooxml.md): add slide part, rels, content-type, sldIdLst."""
    with zipfile.ZipFile(PPTX) as z:
        data = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}

    slides = sorted(
        int(m.group(1)) for n in data if (m := re.match(r"ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml$", n))
    )
    n = max(slides) + 1
    slide_name = f"ppt/slides/slide{n}.xml"
    rels_name = f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{n}.xml.rels"

    prev_rels = data.get(f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{n - 1}.xml.rels", b"")
    m = re.search(rb'Type="[^"]*?/slideLayout" Target="([^"]+)"', prev_rels)
    layout_target = m.group(1).decode() if m else "../slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml"

    slide_xml = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        '<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" '
        'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" '
        'xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main">'
        "<p:cSld><p:spTree>"
        '<p:nvGrpSpPr><p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/><p:cNvGrpSpPr/><p:nvPr/></p:nvGrpSpPr>'
        '<p:grpSpPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>'
        '<a:chOff x="0" y="0"/><a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/></a:xfrm></p:grpSpPr>'
        '<p:sp><p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="2" name="Thanks"/><p:cNvSpPr/><p:nvPr/></p:nvSpPr>'
        '<p:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="685800" y="1828800"/><a:ext cx="10760400" cy="914400"/></a:xfrm></p:spPr>'
        "<p:txBody><a:bodyPr/><a:lstStyle/>"
        '<a:p><a:pPr algn="ctr"/><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="4000" b="1" dirty="0"/>'
        "<a:t>Thank you for your attention</a:t></a:r></a:p>"
        "</p:txBody></p:sp></p:spTree></p:cSld>"
        "<p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr></p:sld>"
    )
    rels_xml = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">'
        f'<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout" '
        f'Target="{layout_target}"/></Relationships>'
    )
    data[slide_name] = slide_xml.encode("utf-8")
    data[rels_name] = rels_xml.encode("utf-8")

    ct = data["[Content_Types].xml"].decode("utf-8")
    if f'/ppt/slides/slide{n}.xml' not in ct:
        ct = ct.replace(
            "</Types>",
            f'<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide{n}.xml" '
            'ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/></Types>',
        )
        data["[Content_Types].xml"] = ct.encode("utf-8")

    prels = data["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"].decode("utf-8")
    rid = max(int(x) for x in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', prels)) + 1
    prels = prels.replace(
        "</Relationships>",
        f'<Relationship Id="rId{rid}" '
        'Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" '
        f'Target="slides/slide{n}.xml"/></Relationships>',
    )
    data["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"] = prels.encode("utf-8")

    pres = data["ppt/presentation.xml"].decode("utf-8")
    sid = max(int(x) for x in re.findall(r'<p:sldId id="(\d+)"', pres)) + 1
    pres = pres.replace(
        "</p:sldIdLst>", f'<p:sldId id="{sid}" r:id="rId{rid}"/></p:sldIdLst>'
    )
    data["ppt/presentation.xml"] = pres.encode("utf-8")

    if "docProps/app.xml" in data:
        app = data["docProps/app.xml"].decode("utf-8")
        app = re.sub(r"(<Slides>)(\d+)(</Slides>)", lambda mm: mm.group(1) + str(int(mm.group(2)) + 1) + mm.group(3), app)
        data["docProps/app.xml"] = app.encode("utf-8")

    tmp = PPTX + ".tmp"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for name, blob in data.items():
            z.writestr(name, blob)
    os.replace(tmp, PPTX)


def main():
    try:
        import pptx  # noqa: F401

        add_with_pptx()
        print("slide added via python-pptx")
    except ImportError:
        add_with_zip()
        print("slide added via raw OOXML zip edit")
    if not verify_pptx(PPTX):
        sys.exit("error: verification failed")
    print("done")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
